reviews.text: Super good help and service 🙌 …

Very good service from nice people! I have been a customer for several years, and it is always nice to stop by. Several good tips, and there is a solution-oriented staff if something should arise. Recommended!

Very happy with Dyresjappa Oslo! 🐾 Here you get incredibly good service, nice people and real commitment to the animals.
An extra big thank you to the manager Maja – she is absolutely awesome! Incredibly skilled, helpful and always gentle and accommodating. You can really tell that she is passionate about both the customers and the animals.

Highly recommended! ❤️🐶🐱

The pet shop is great! Good old-fashioned service from start to finish. The drivers are also top class in terms of service and friendliness.

I'll be back here again, greeted by friendly ladies with a lot of knowledge who are responsive and interested in what is being said. Both dog and owner felt well taken care of. Worth driving an hour for the experience 🐾🥰 …

VERY competent people, I didn't realize how incompetent my original pet store was BEFORE I came here!

Helped me find good kibble for my little old dog who is ALSO picky. I HAVE BECOME PICKY about what I feed my animals. Bought three products and all three were bankers for my dog!

And the seller knew what I was talking about and more! and also cared about CLEAN products for the animals!

Will definitely be stopping by here when I'm in the area!! Muchas gracias!!

Fairly ok shop, if you don’t mind the gamble of sometimes getting a really helpful staff member and sometimes getting a comedically rude staff member. I’m not a gambling man so I prefer to use another pet shop.

Generally ok, albeit reasonably high prices. But when you arrive five minutes before closing time and find out that “we haven’t had any customers for the last half hour, so we’ve been allowed to close early” — that’s how you lose customers, and stars.

Dyresjappa impresses with really good customer service! They follow up on orders and quickly notify you of stock status, changes in prices and delivery via text message. Nice products and a decent environmental and quality profile.
